_note: 學習路徑內容：學測參考 4500 字表精熟（eng.t_adv.vocab.ceec-4500，學測級／進階）。此為『詞彙能力／策略』型 KP，不是列出全部 4500 字——教的是『認識學測參考詞彙表範圍的概念』＋『如何系統化擴充字彙』的策略（word family／字首字尾／由上下文推義／間隔複習），並舉代表性字例。R14 用英文學英文，中文對照收合於 zh_hint。每題唯一客觀正解（字首字尾功能、詞族詞性、策略選擇）。字義／規則依 Cambridge／Oxford；字表範圍依大考中心高中英文參考詞彙表／課綱，標 provisional＋待英語母語 reviewer 複核。無音檔。

units.title_zh: 學測參考 4500 字表精熟（概念與擴充策略）
units.can_do: 我知道學測參考詞彙表大約 4,500 字的範圍是什麼，也會用系統化策略（詞族、字首字尾、由上下文推義、間隔複習）持續擴充自己的字彙。
units.situation_group: 字彙：學測字表與擴充策略
units.subject: eng

claims.text: The reference word list used for Taiwan's college entrance English exam sorts words into levels; about 4,500 of them (the earlier levels) are the main target for the GSAT (學測).
source_refs: 大學入學考試中心 高中英文參考詞彙表
十二年國教英語文領域課程綱要
claims.verification_ref: 學測參考詞彙表範圍約 4,500 字（大考中心參考詞彙表／課綱常引數字）；『約』為概數，待英語母語／課綱 reviewer 複核確切級距

claims.text: Many words belong to the same word family built on one root. From 'nation' you get 'national' (adjective) and 'nationality' (noun); add the prefix inter- to 'national' and you get 'international'. Learning one root helps you understand several words.
claims.verification_ref: 詞族：同一字根衍生相關字（nation→national 形容詞、nation→nationality 名詞；inter-＋national→international，非由 nationality 衍生）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The prefix 'un-' usually means 'not': happy -> unhappy, kind -> unkind, able -> unable.
claims.verification_ref: 字首 un- 多表『不／否定』（unhappy／unkind／unable）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When you meet an unknown word while reading and have no dictionary, you can often guess its meaning from the context — the other words and sentences around it.
claims.verification_ref: 由上下文推義是閱讀時處理生字的有效策略；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Reviewing words a little, several times over days and weeks (spaced review) helps you remember them for longer than studying them only once.
claims.verification_ref: 間隔複習（分散於數日／數週）比一次性記憶更能長期保留；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: The GSAT (the college entrance exam) is based on a reference word list of about 4,500 words. You do not learn this list by reading it from top to bottom. Instead, you build your vocabulary with smart strategies, a little every day.
teach.zh_hint: 學測以一份約 4,500 字的參考詞彙表為範圍。你不是從頭到尾把字表背完，而是用聰明的策略、每天一點一點累積字彙。

teach.body: One root, many words. From 'nation': national (adjective) and nationality (noun). Add inter- to 'national' to get international. Learning the root 'nation' helps you understand the whole family.
teach.zh_hint: 一個字根，很多字。從 nation 來：national（形容詞）、nationality（名詞）；在 national 前加 inter- 就是 international。學會字根 nation，就能看懂一整組字。

teach.body: Three useful strategies: (1) Affixes: the prefix 'un-' usually means 'not' (unhappy, unkind). (2) Context: guess a new word from the words around it. (3) Spaced review: see each word again a few times over weeks so it stays in memory.
teach.zh_hint: 三個好用策略：(1) 字首字尾：un- 多表『不』（unhappy、unkind）。(2) 上下文：用旁邊的字去猜生字。(3) 間隔複習：每個字隔幾天再看幾次，才記得牢。

practice.stem: Which prefix usually means 'not'?  ____ + happy = not happy

distractor_rationales.re-: re- 多表『再一次／回』（redo、return），不是『不』。
distractor_rationales.pre-: pre- 多表『在…之前』（preview、prepay），不是『不』。
distractor_rationales.-ful: -ful 是字尾，表『充滿…的』（helpful、careful），不是表否定的字首。

practice.stem: 'nation' is a noun. Which word in the same word family is the adjective (describing word)?

distractor_rationales.nation: nation 是名詞本身，不是形容詞。
distractor_rationales.nations: nations 只是 nation 的複數名詞，不是形容詞。
distractor_rationales.nationally: nationally 以 -ly 結尾，是副詞，不是形容詞。

practice.feedback: 同詞族的形容詞是 national（national team 國家隊）。

practice.stem: You meet a new word while reading and have no dictionary. What is the best first strategy?
practice.answer: Guess its meaning from nearby words.
options: Guess its meaning from nearby words.
Just skip over the whole page and keep going.

停下來不讀，就無法用上下文幫你理解，也學不到這個字。
distractor_rationales.Just skip over the whole page and keep g: 整頁跳過會錯過整段意思，一個生字不值得放棄整頁。
每個字都先翻譯會非常慢，也不是閱讀時處理單一生字的好方法。

practice.feedback: 先用上下文（旁邊的字句）推測生字的意思，是最有效率的第一步。

practice.stem: Which is the best way to remember many new words for a long time?
practice.answer: Review them a little, several times over weeks.
options: Review them a little, several times over weeks.
Read them once the night before the exam.
Write each word 100 times in one hour.
Read the list silently only one time.

distractor_rationales.Read them once the night before the exam: 考前一晚只看一次，記得短、忘得快。
一小時內狂抄 100 遍是集中、短時的練習，長期保留效果不如分散複習。
只默讀一次，過幾天多半就忘了。

practice.feedback: 間隔複習：每個字隔幾天再看幾次，記憶才會長久。

practice.stem: About how many words make up the GSAT (學測) vocabulary range?

distractor_rationales.about 100: 100 字遠少於學測範圍，連基礎日常字都不夠。
distractor_rationales.about 50,000: 50,000 接近母語成人的字彙量，遠超過學測參考字表。
distractor_rationales.about 300: 300 字太少，約是入門幾週的量，不是學測範圍。

practice.feedback: 學測參考詞彙表範圍約 4,500 字（概數）。重點是用策略持續擴充，而不是死背整張表。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。
